henry.title: Sound Engineering with Song Maker
henry.intro: Music has patterns, like code! Rhythm and pitch are engineering tools for sound.
worksheet: What makes a note higher or lower?
Describe your rocket theme in 3 words.
Draw a blueprint-style picture of your song (shapes for notes).
How many beats did you use?

frankie.title: Draw Your Superhero Song
frankie.intro: Draw lines and shapes and hear them make music!
steps: Play Kandinsky — draw and press play.
Draw your own superhero on the sheet.
worksheet: Clap your name! How many claps? ___
